prompt: Create a polished, information-dense educational infographic about the fictional annual goblin hibernation cycle. Landscape 3:2 composition, stylized layered 2.5D diorama, crisp editorial field-guide design, carved paper strata, dimensional cutouts, soft ambient shadows, fine ink details, moss green, umber, amber, icy teal. Clear visual hierarchy and generous label spacing. A clockwise seasonal loop surrounds a central cross-section of a cozy underground burrow. Four phases visually distinct and joined by curved arrows: autumn preparation, winter sleep, spring awakening, summer feeding. Charming non-scary goblins, richly detailed miniature roots, mushrooms, acorns, snow crystals, lanterns, blankets, burrow tunnels, fungi, leaves, timeline ticks. Professional museum infographic. Exact labels only where specified; avoid other text or gibberish. Keep all composition elements inside margins.
negativePrompt: photorealism, horror, gore, clutter, unreadable text, misspellings, random letters, logos, watermark, flat vector-only style, blurry, low detail, cropped title, overlapping labels
